summary: The implementation fully and faithfully achieves the saved plan. auth_mounts.py: capability-aware teardown_workspace_auth_overlay with the .overlay-unmounted marker, OverlayUnmountUnverifiableError(reason_code=CLAUDE_AUTH_OVERLAY_UNMOUNT_INCAPABLE), and the AWF_CLAUDE_AUTH_FORCE_COPY supported()-gate — sibling base/staging/signature regions untouched per the non-goal. gc.py + new gc_auth_overlay.py: loud-failure path returns (reason_code,message) on Unverifiable or (OSError, SubprocessError), appends a WorkspaceGCDeleteError, records the auth path as 'skipped' (never rmtree over a possibly-live mount), and drives status='partial'. worker cleanup.py: _teardown_terminal_auth_overlay runs on terminal-runtime-release via asyncio.to_thread, adds auth_overlay_unmounted to the released event, and degrades gracefully on OverlayUnmountUnverifiableError/OSError/SubprocessError without blocking port reclaim. manager.py + worker.py wire auth_overlay_work_dir=work_dir (plan option a). bootstrap.py: ensure_work_dir_mount_propagation preflight parses /proc/self/mountinfo, makes the work dir rshared when possible, else forces the copy fallback (non-propagating fs / non-Linux / missing mount / make-rshared failure) with ENSURED/UNAVAILABLE reason codes, recorded as a work_dir_propagation stage and folded into AWF_WORK_DIR_BIND_PROPAGATION + AWF_CLAUDE_AUTH_FORCE_COPY. Compose binds are propagation-gated and AWF_CLAUDE_AUTH_FORCE_COPY added to x-awf-environment. cli/common.py adds warn_on_overlay_unmount_failure wired into service_gc. All five planned TDD test areas are present and assert the specific behaviors (mounted->unmount+marker, real-umount-error reraise, incapable+upper+no-marker->Unverifiable, incapable+marker/legacy->noop, capable+not-mounted->marker, force-copy env gate; GC partial+skipped+reason; worker unmount=True / failure-not-blocking / Unverifiable-not-aborting / no-work-dir-skip; bootstrap shared / private-made-rshared / missing-mountinfo / non-propagating-fs / make-rshared-failure; CLI partial exit + warning). Non-goals respected (sibling shared-BASE functions not edited; COMPLETED path unchanged). Iteration-1 regressions are fixed: gc.py is 1453 lines (under the 1500 guardrail) and the worker-entrypoint test stub accepts auth_overlay_work_dir. Fresh branch-coverage evidence (.coverage at 2026-06-04 09:13, after the last commit 0ddee6e83 at 09:00) includes all changed files with rich arc data (gc_auth_overlay.py, auth_mounts.py, bootstrap.py, cleanup.py, common.py), confirming the new paths were exercised by the suite against the current tree. AWF/GitHub CI owns the final hard 99% coverage + lint/type gate.
